queries.result: First-party results identified the official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS geospatial portal and an official Kota Tanjungbalai report naming the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Tanjungbalai. The portal's public catalog did not list a Tanjung Balai parcel dataset.

queries.result: First-party results again identified the Kota Tanjungbalai/BPN local land office and ATR/BPN BHUMI. The official city report documents PTSL mapping and certificates, but does not expose an anonymous downloadable parcel layer.

registryBasis: The official Kota Tanjungbalai publication identifies the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Tanjungbalai/BPN office as the land-registration and PTSL mapping custodian. This is distinguished from the national ATR/BPN portal and its general geospatial services.

officialSources.observation: Official city report names the Kepala Kantor Pertanahan Kota Tanjungbalai and describes PTSL land-field mapping and certificates; it is evidence of local custody, not an open parcel API.
Current BHUMI/ATLAS portal. Its JavaScript loads the public GeoNode catalog and its map configuration points to the ATR/BPN GeoServer WMS/WFS endpoints.
Official cadastral base-map regulation; general policy/procedure context, not city-specific parcel coverage.
